text: {"question":"Which numerical result in the data comparison demonstrates that a MeV‑scale confinement scenario yields a Hubble constant around 71.6 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹, thereby supporting the claim that this model can alleviate the H₀ tension?","reference_answer":"The table lists the H₀ value for the DQCD model as 71.69 ± 0.68 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹, which is close to the quoted 71.60 ± 0.63 and significantly higher than the baseline ΛCDM value of 68.75 ± 0.27, illustrating the model’s ability to reduce the H₀ discrepancy."}
